name: Find synonyms and alternative word expressions
description: Users asked for synonyms, alternative phrasings, or similar words for specific terms and phrases in various languages, often requesting multiple options or context-specific replacements. Some users also sought antonyms, rhymes, creative neologisms, or the etymological and stylistic nuances of particular vocabulary choices.
